title: The Big Bee 28.5 V Starting Cart – 28 V DC
description: The Big Bee is designed for private owners, corporate operators and FBOs. 28.5 volts of “pure” DC (no AC ripple) Designed for use on all aircraft, 12 or 24 volt Repeatedly gives quick, efficient starts Expect 20–25 starts between charges External 28 volt charger with 11–hour timer and ammeter included 11 foot main 4/0 heavy duty starting cable included Pneumatic 12” tires with roller bearings and grease fittings 12 volt isolated receptacle, 12 volt cable with alligator clips included
